models_evaluated: image-based surgical site infection detection model

links.outcome: AUROC of SSI detection model across age, gender, race, skin color, and geography subgroups
links.effect: No differences for age, gender, race, or skin color (AUROC 0.83-0.87, p>0.09); geographic differences significant: lowest AUROC 0.83 vs. highest 0.87 (p=0.01).
links.quote: No differences in SSI detection existed for age, gender, race, or skin color (AUROC 0.83-0.87, p>0.09), however geographical differences were significant: lowest AUROC 0.83 (95% CI 0.77-0.88) vs. highest AUROC 0.87 (95% CI 0.84-0.89, p=0.01).

links.outcome: Model performance variation across geographic sites
links.effect: Geographic AUROC differences significant (0.83 vs 0.87, p=0.01); temporal validation showed geography ΔAUROC ≤0.16 versus ≤0.06 for other subgroups.
links.quote: Temporal validation using 4,242 images from 1,353 patients between 2022-2023 showed intact fairness across subgroups (ΔAUROC ≤0.06) except geography (ΔAUROC ≤0.16).

screen.reason: Empirical retrospective evaluation specifically assessing algorithmic fairness and bias across subgroups (age, gender, geography, race, skin tone) for an SSI imaging diagnostic model before clinical implementation.
